title: Flexible Brackets
commonMistakes: Assigning every joker the same role
Allowing the lower balance to go below zero
Forgetting to fail when the maximum balance becomes negative
Accepting a string whose minimum possible final balance is greater than zero
followUps: How would you count the number of valid joker assignments?
What if a joker could stand for at most two brackets rather than any one?
How would the problem change if square and curly brackets were also present?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
